Only Taylor's own combative reply to the ensuing criticism, and the critics' replies, could be verbatim-verified and are included.

No manufacturing units-per-year figure found stated by any of the three companies for their eventual factories (Aalo's Austin 'Reactor Factory', Valar's Utah fabrication facility, or Deep Fission's borehole-drilling operation) -- all three describe factory/site locations but none states a production-rate target in a fetchable source.

No verbatim quote found from Mo Shahzad or Mark Mitchell themselves in the 2024-08 to 2026-08 window (Mitchell's only located quote is from his April 2024 hire announcement, one month before the window opens, so it was used only for the leader bio, not the quotes array).

Valar Atomics' own site (valaratomics.com root and /docs) carries almost no leadership-bio or hard-number content; all Valar leader and quote material came from third-party press coverage and one prior hire press release instead.

No SEC filing (10-K or S-1) from Deep Fission repeats the $50-70/MWh LCOE or 5-7 cents/kWh figures that CEO Liz Muller has stated in press releases and podcasts; this discrepancy is treated as a finding (see quotes), not an absence, but the underlying 'why' (e.g. an SEC comment-letter objection) was not found in a fetchable source.

Dropped deepfission-muller-leu-fuel 2026-08-30: fewer than six words of the transcribed podcast quote appear verbatim in the cited page, so it could not ship as a quotation. The underlying fact (Deep Fission buys 5% low-enriched uranium) is carried by deepfission-10k-leu-commitment, sourced to the company's own 10-K, which is the stronger citation anyway.

quotes.speaker: Yasir Arafat
quotes.venue: Aalo Atomics company blog -- "Unlocking Hypergrowth: Our Bold Move in Nuclear Fuel"
quotes.quote: HALEU, once promising for its improved performance, encountered major setbacks when geopolitical tensions disrupted its primary supply route from Russia
quotes.what_it_means: Aalo publicly rejected HALEU -- the fuel most other advanced-reactor startups are chasing -- citing Russia-linked enrichment supply risk, not just cost or performance. It chose standard 5-8% enriched UO2 instead, trading some reactor performance for near-term fuel availability. Deep Fission, in this same file, cites the identical rationale (see its supply-chain quotes).

quotes.speaker: Isaiah Taylor
quotes.venue: Nuclear Engineering International -- "Valar Atomics reactor airlifted to Utah"
quotes.quote: Zero power criticality is a reactor's first heartbeat, proof the physics holds. I'm incredibly proud of the Valar team that took this from blueprint to splitting the atom, securing the first criticality ever achieved by a venture-backed company.
quotes.what_it_means: This February 2026 claim is distinct from Valar's later, fueled zero-power criticality demonstration at Utah's USREL site in June 2026 (below), which World Nuclear News describes as the SECOND of four companies to meet the DOE Reactor Pilot Program's July 4, 2026 deadline, after Antares Nuclear. Neutron Bytes, citing former DOE official Katy Huff, reports that this February event was 'a cold zero power test that did not take the fuel up to actual power densities' -- a lower bar than a fueled test at power, and the specific claim this quote is describing.

quotes.speaker: Isaiah Taylor
quotes.venue: KSL.com -- "Valar Atomics' nuclear reactor reaches criticality in Utah"
quotes.quote: A few minutes ago, we took Ward250
quotes.what_it_means: This is the DOE Reactor Pilot Program milestone: a fueled, zero-power criticality demonstration at the Utah San Rafael Energy Lab (USREL), reported as the second of four companies to meet the program's July 4, 2026 deadline. Taylor also told KSL that Valar's 'guiding principle was that metal beats paper' -- build hardware before finishing analysis -- which is the same fast-over-rigorous approach independent nuclear engineers criticize in the skeptic-case quotes below. It is zero-power only, not the reactor generating electricity.

quotes.speaker: Katy Huff
quotes.role: Former U.S. DOE Assistant Secretary for Nuclear Energy -- independent critic quoted by Neutron Bytes, not affiliated with Valar
quotes.venue: Neutron Bytes -- "Questions Abound About Valar Atomics" (citing Huff's comments to Latitude News Media)
quotes.quote: A 'zero power criticality test' can be achieved without making real engineering progress on fuel or design; it simply checks if you can multiply neutrons.
quotes.what_it_means: Huff, a former senior DOE nuclear-energy official, directly deflates the significance of a 'criticality' headline -- the same milestone Taylor celebrated as 'the first heartbeat' (above). quotes.quote: Given his hypersensitive and toxic reaction to my simple critique of his outrageous radiation claim, I think his reactor should be scrutinized quite a bit by independent experts before anyone allows him to turn it
quotes.what_it_means: Touran's response to Taylor's pushback (companion record above): his substantive point is that Valar's spent-fuel radiation-safety claim was not just wrong but 'outrageous,' and that Taylor reacting to being challenged rather than engaging on the engineering is itself a reason for third-party scrutiny before licensing.

quotes.speaker: Kip Mock
quotes.venue: GMA News -- "US nuke firm partners with PNRI to build 'research reactor' in PH"
quotes.quote: We think that it's really important to develop this technology here and collaborate with the PNRI and PNSF, and local universities
quotes.what_it_means: Valar's Philippines project, with the Philippine Nuclear Research Institute, is explicitly a non-grid-connected, sub-scale proof-of-concept -- Mock elsewhere in the same article calls the reactor 'a micro high temperature gas reactor' and says it is 'the first time this type of reactor has been built in the Philippines.' It is not a power-producing customer deployment, and it is the only announced overseas site among the three companies in this file.

quotes.speaker: Khevin Yu
quotes.role: Campaigner, Greenpeace Philippines -- critic, not affiliated with Valar
quotes.venue: Greenpeace Philippines press release -- "Greenpeace denounces PNRI-Valar Atomics nuclear deal"
quotes.quote: The micro reactors Valar Atomics proposed remain untested and exist solely on paper. This agreement effectively sets up our people as guinea pigs for unproven and inherently risky
quotes.what_it_means: Local environmental opposition in the Philippines predates Valar's actual construction there -- this statement is from around November 2024, before the specific reactor design and university site were finalized -- and frames the deployment as testing unproven technology on Filipino citizens, a distinct international-relations risk alongside the domestic technical-credibility questions raised by Touran and Erickson.
